summary: BUUU Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that majority-owned subsidiary Brightray Science Inc., through Brightray Veridian Pte. Ltd., signed a non-binding letter of intent on October 6, 2026 with an unnamed U.S. mission-critical infrastructure partner for a planned 10MW AI data center in Indiana. The LOI contemplates a purchase order by November 15, 2026 and expires 12 months after signing. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; this is an ordinary commercial business development disclosure, not a special situation, with execution and definitive-contract risk to watch.
